title: Keep rule tests off open-trap workaround text
body: Outcome: a rule test never asserts the text of an open trap workaround, so removing a fixed trap from krn-lead does not break an unrelated test. Evidence: PR #172 krn verify preflight FAIL (.krn/runs/delivery-loop/deliver-traps/verify-1.out) because test/rules/parallel-lanes.test.ts asserted "bind: record/PR head mismatch" from the t-zwba7pr workaround; one extra verify cycle. Acceptance: test/rules/lead-traps.test.ts (or a new rule test) fails when a test under test/rules/ matches a workaround sentence owned by an Open traps id, or krn-lead step 6 states that trap text is asserted only by lead-traps.test.ts.
